title: The main theorem of polytopes
abstract: Formalizes the Minkowski–Weyl theorem — the equivalence between V-polytopes (convex hulls of finite point sets) and bounded H-polytopes (finite intersections of half-spaces) in a finite-dimensional real vector space.

informal.MainTheoremOfPolytopes: The Minkowski–Weyl theorem — a set is a V-polytope iff it is a bounded H-polytope.
informal.Vpolytope_of_Hpolytope: Every bounded H-polytope (finite intersection of half-spaces) is the convex hull of a finite point set.
